_about: Machine-readable screen inventory for the Spread publish finalize program. Authoritative list of native screens, sheets, widgets and the landing page. Human companion: SCREEN_MAP.md. Status vocabulary: planned | designed | implemented | verified. 'verified' requires device or test evidence tied to a named commit; none exists yet (see RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md). Paths are repository-relative. Line counts were read at the commit this file was written against.

_status_legend.planned: named and scoped, no design or implementation claim
_status_legend.designed: a design document in this repo specifies the surface, but source is absent or incomplete
_status_legend.implemented: integrated source exists in the repo; not compiled or run by this lane
_status_legend.verified: device or test evidence exists for the reviewed revision

screens.name: Planner launch, loading and recovery
screens.purpose: Opens the local planner and shows a recovery path when storage cannot be read or saved.
screens.exit: Classic root or Life root; Backup sheet from the recovery state.
states: save failed with Retry saving and Back up
screens.notes: Launch-time recovery copy is in SpreadLiveRoot.swift near the error alert; not reviewed on device.

screens.name: Classic: Spread (responsibilities)
screens.purpose: Shows each responsibility with its hours and tasks. Default destination of Classic.
screens.exit: Week or Month via rail; Responsibility and Task sheets.
states: empty: 'Make room for what matters' with Create responsibility
screens.notes: Empty-state CTA uses Spread.accentGradient and ChalkMotionArt (Classic keeps Chalk per its own rules). Entry, empty-state CTA and sidebar all say 'Add responsibility' (OD22, applied). Classic has two removal dialogs with different verbs; see N20 and corrections/life-routing.md (X3).

screens.name: Classic: Week
screens.purpose: Seven day cards with hours per responsibility, a To place inbox for unplaced tasks and an overdue tray.
screens.entry: Navigation rail Week; Month header returns here.
screens.exit: Task sheet, Move-to sheet, Month, Carry-over review.
screens.notes: To place casing is 'To place' on the Week tray and rows. Recently Deleted now says 'To place' too (#218; corrections/copy-voice.md).

screens.name: Classic: Month
screens.purpose: Month grid with plan days. Tapping a day opens that day in Week.
screens.notes: Plan days on the month grid shipped in PR #206 (see git history).

screens.name: Classic: Month quick add
screens.purpose: Adds a task to a chosen day from Month without opening Week.
screens.exit: Dismiss or save; returns to Month.

screens.name: Classic: navigation rail, header and week navigator
screens.purpose: Switches Spread, Hours and Week; steps the calendar period one week or month at a time.
screens.entry: Always visible in Classic; collapsed or expanded.
screens.exit: Any destination; period tap opens the value alert.
screens.notes: WeekCrownView keeps its legacy name; it is a plain arrow/value/arrow control, not a metal Crown. Rename is a Lane A decision. Icon and token work is tracked in corrections/wave2-tokens-icons.md.

screens.name: Life: root with destinations
screens.purpose: Single Wallet-style root with Life, Hours and Week destinations, a labeled toggle and collapsible navigation.
screens.entry: More, Calendar design, Life (or a widget deep link, which switches to Life).
screens.exit: More sheet; Task, Details, Plan Ahead, Focus timer.
screens.notes: Life is the default root (OD18, applied: SpreadLiveRoot.swift:16 defaults the flag to true). The flag key keeps its old name so a stored choice survives. Cross-surface review: after a change, two Undo rows can show (X2, corrections/life-routing.md).

screens.name: Life: Wallet Stack of Life area cards
screens.purpose: Shows each Life area as an editorial card in one stack; a focused card reveals its week and actions.
screens.exit: Focus a card; Details, Tasks, Hours, Week.
screens.notes: Editorial artwork is text-free by rule; names and hours are native SwiftUI.

screens.name: Life: card Details sheet
screens.purpose: Edits a Life area's name, hours, icon and color, and deletes it with Undo.
screens.exit: Dismiss; delete returns to the stack with Undo.
screens.notes: Title on main is 'Details' (LifeManagementSheets.swift:96, OD8 applied). Delete is undoable without a confirmation prompt, per the Nov 11 amendment and OD24. Device step B2 and B3 in DEVICE_TEST_SCRIPT.md check it.

screens.name: Life: card Tasks notebook
screens.purpose: Free-form notes for one Life area, with its task rows.

screens.name: Life: Hours allocator
screens.purpose: Shows the weekly hour budget per Life area and edits capacity and role budgets.
screens.entry: Life destination Hours; Weekly Time strip summary button.
screens.notes: The Life/ folder holds 7 .system(size:) calls and 16 Color(hex:/red:) calls; some Color(hex:) uses read role data, not hardcoded values. Per-line detail belongs in TOKEN_AUDIT.md (Lane A).

screens.name: Life: Weekly Time strip
screens.purpose: Compact capacity bar in Life; expands in place to adjust weekly hours through existing planner actions.
screens.notes: Over-budget wording reads 'Over budget' here and in the card (LifeWeeklyTimeBudget.swift:69, 126, 273; LifeEditorialCard.swift:155, 205). Classic says 'overbooked' (X5, owner decision; corrections/copy-voice.md).

screens.name: Life: Week
screens.purpose: The current week for the focused Life area: days, a To place inbox and week navigation.
screens.notes: Does not reuse Classic WeekSurface; two week implementations exist. See corrections/life-routing.md.

screens.name: Life: Plan Ahead sheet
screens.purpose: Previews, then confirms, moving hours from this week to a future week. Never automatic.
screens.notes: Copy: 'Nothing moves until you preview and confirm.'

screens.name: Life: recurring schedule form
screens.purpose: Creates or edits a repeating weekly schedule for a Life area.
screens.exit: Save or cancel; Stop repeating confirmation.

screens.name: Life: Reserve and Priority sheets
screens.purpose: Reserve hours for a Life area; set the optional high-priority red ! flag.
screens.notes: Priority is a flag, not a scheduling change, per the rules card.

screens.name: Life: quick add and add task
screens.purpose: Adds a task to a Life area from the stack or as a sheet.
screens.entry: Life root Add Life or the card's add control.
screens.notes: Creation label is 'Add Life' here; see corrections/copy-voice.md.

screens.name: Life: gesture help
screens.purpose: Explains the Life gestures and where each action lives.

screens.name: Task sheet
screens.purpose: Creates or edits one task: text, responsibility, day and hours, priority, photo attachment; deletes with confirmation.
screens.entry: Any task row; Add task; Life card.
screens.notes: Shared with Life through lifeMode.

screens.name: Responsibility (Spread) sheet
screens.purpose: Edits one responsibility and removes it with confirmation.
screens.entry: Responsibility header in Spread or Week.
screens.notes: Removing a responsibility from Classic: 'Remove responsibility' dialog here (ManageSheets.swift:234, 260). The edit-mode row uses 'Delete responsibility' (SpreadSurface.swift:955-975). One verb is an owner decision (X3; corrections/life-routing.md).

screens.name: New responsibility sheet
screens.purpose: Creates a responsibility with a name, hours, icon and color.
screens.entry: Classic: Create responsibility, New Spread; More.
screens.notes: The title follows the root that opened it: 'Add Life' in Life and 'Add responsibility' in Classic (ManageSheets.swift:64, PR #218). Field labels follow the same rule (lane W2-4 closed).

screens.name: Carry-over review sheet
screens.purpose: Reviews unfinished tasks from earlier weeks and offers to carry them forward.
screens.entry: Classic Week and Spread review actions (LiveSheet.review).
screens.notes: Rollover is never automatic (rules card). Entry is Classic only; Life has no equivalent entry.

screens.name: More (settings) sheet
screens.purpose: Calendar design (Classic or Life), appearance, reminders, Recently Deleted, What's New, Focus timer, Backup and restore, profiles.
screens.entry: Gear in the header or dock.
screens.notes: This is the only place a user can switch to Life outside widget deep links. OD18 removes the "(current)" label from Classic and makes Life the default. See corrections/life-routing.md.

screens.name: Profiles sheet
screens.purpose: Lists profiles, switches between them and removes one with its spreads.
screens.notes: Profile limit is 10 (src/lib/spread/profiles.ts).

screens.name: Backup and restore sheet
screens.purpose: Creates a .spread backup or a plan file; previews a restore before anything changes.
screens.entry: More, Backup and restore; recovery state.
screens.owner_lane: none: backup and restore is excluded from polish by the Spread boundaries
screens.notes: Not reviewed for design in this lane. Changes need a separate owner decision.

screens.name: Recently Deleted sheet
screens.purpose: Restores or permanently removes deleted tasks within the 30-day window.
states: unreadable: 'Recently Deleted could not be read. Nothing was removed.'
screens.notes: Copy says 'return to To place' (RecentlyDeletedSheet.swift:23, PR #218). Closed.

screens.name: What's New sheet
screens.purpose: Shows release notes once after an update.
screens.notes: ReleaseNotes.swift is in Lane D's owned list.

screens.name: Reminder settings sheet
screens.purpose: Turns focus and planned-block reminders on or off; notifications are requested only on opt-in.

screens.name: Replace next week? confirmation
screens.purpose: Confirms that copying this week replaces next week's tasks and days.
screens.notes: Destructive; uses a danger-tinted primary button.

screens.name: Remove responsibility confirmation
screens.purpose: Confirms that removing a responsibility removes its hours and tasks from every week.
screens.notes: Life removes cards with Undo instead; the two paths differ. Owner decision.

screens.name: Week export
screens.purpose: Exports the current week as a document the user can share or print.
screens.entry: Week export action (call site not traced in this pass).
screens.notes: Entry point not verified.

screens.name: To place tray and Move-to sheet
screens.purpose: Holds tasks that have no day yet; Move-to chooses a responsibility or day.

screens.name: Overdue selection tray and preview
screens.purpose: Selects overdue tasks and previews where they will move before any change.

screens.name: Undo notice
screens.purpose: Offers Undo for the last change, for a limited time, above the Home indicator.
screens.exit: Undo, timeout or the next change.
screens.notes: Position above the home indicator is required by the Spread motion contract; not device-verified (device step B5). On Life, a second Undo row (the Undo and Redo pair in LifeRoot.swift:707-714) can show with it (X2).

screens.name: Focus timer sheet
screens.purpose: Runs a focus session for a planned block; pauses, ends and reflects the day's plan.
screens.entry: Life root Focus; More, Focus timer; widget.
screens.exit: End session or dismiss; Live Activity continues.
screens.notes: Presented from LifeRoot and from More. Done is trailing (OD6). Transport controls are 44 pt and grow with Dynamic Type (OD10). Icon and token work is tracked in corrections/wave2-tokens-icons.md.

screens.name: Focus Live Activity
screens.purpose: Shows the running focus timer on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, with pause and end intents.
screens.notes: ActivityConfiguration is declared in SpreadTodayWidget.swift. The Live Activity's cancel action reads 'Cancel' (SpreadTimerWidget.swift:226), while the Focus sheet reads 'Cancel session' (X10; corrections/copy-voice.md). Presentations not device-verified (device step H3).

screens.name: Classic: Week focus surface (unreachable)
screens.purpose: A focused Week layout that is only built when the Life flag is on and the Classic path is active.
screens.entry: None reachable: SpreadLiveRoot.body shows LifeRoot when the flag is on and never builds Classic content in that case.
screens.notes: Dead-path candidate: the only construction site is SpreadLiveRoot.swift content(), which runs only when weekFocusEnabled is false. OD19 decides deletion in wave 2 (lane W2-1). Not yet removed on main.

screens.name: Today widget
screens.purpose: Shows today's planned blocks and tasks.
screens.entry: Home or Lock Screen widget gallery.
screens.exit: Tap opens Today in the app.

screens.name: Focus timer widget
screens.purpose: Shows the focus timer state and a control to start or pause.
screens.entry: Home or Lock Screen widget gallery.
screens.notes: Sized in PR #206.

screens.name: Life cards widget
screens.purpose: Shows Life cards with their editorial artwork and the week's time.
screens.entry: Home or Lock Screen widget gallery.
screens.exit: Tap opens that Life card in the app.
screens.notes: Editorial copies in ios/App/SpreadWidget/Editorial are byte-identical to Resources/Editorial today (checked with cmp). They are copied by build step; keep them in sync if artwork changes.

screens.name: Landing: navigation, appearance switch and footer
screens.purpose: Identifies Spread, links the sections, switches light and dark, and links the privacy policy.
screens.exit: Anchor sections; TestFlight link; privacy policy.
screens.notes: Nav CTA 'Join the beta' goes to #start, which holds the TestFlight button.

screens.name: Landing: hero
screens.purpose: Introduces the product with the fanned stack of spread cards and orbiting tasks.
states: tap or hover deal into week
screens.notes: Touch drag on a phone not verified on device.

screens.name: Landing: How it works
screens.purpose: One sample week builds itself as three steps scroll past.
screens.notes: Sample role colors are hardcoded; see corrections/color-drift.md.

screens.name: Landing: week band
screens.purpose: Copy, a 15-of-168-hour tile and an interactive week preview that share one role selection.

screens.name: Landing: story (paper to product)
screens.purpose: The handwritten Sunday page beside the Spread card; each handwritten responsibility carries across.
screens.notes: Copy is the founder's; unchanged.

screens.name: Landing: philosophy (to-do list versus spread)
screens.purpose: A to-do list beside the same tasks grouped by responsibility.

screens.name: Landing: privacy facts
screens.purpose: Four plain facts: nothing to sync, on this device, profiles, backup and restore.
screens.notes: 'Nothing to sync' is accurate only while cloud flags stay off; see corrections/release-scope.md.

screens.name: Landing: start (168 hours and TestFlight)
screens.purpose: The 168-cell week with 15 hours placed, and the TestFlight beta link.
screens.notes: No App Store link exists yet. The release plan says update the CTA only after the public listing is live.
